02

NASA RASC-AL • SENIOR DESIGN • IN PROGRESS

Autonomous Lunar Traverse System

Currently in the research and concept-development phase of our NASA RASC-AL senior design project, focused on an autonomous lunar traverse system for the Moon’s south pole and permanently shadowed regions. I serve as the team’s CAD lead and will begin developing the system’s 3D model as the design takes shape. Our current work includes defining mission requirements, creating functional decompositions, and developing an RTV (requirements traceability and verification) table and Gantt chart to organize design tasks and project milestones.
